name: source-distance-radial
description: Diagnostic: a radial distance field from a fixed point, built in-graph from a position bake and distance() — the derivation that replaced the distance source's point form. The mask's texel values equal the old source's exactly: raw position-bake texels are p/256 + 0.5, so distance() of them is world distance / 256. The distance source itself remains for skeleton nodes only.

pos.note: Bind-pose position, -128..128 as 0..1; [0.5, 0.5, 0.5] is the skeleton root

distanceField.note: World distance from the skeleton root / 256, the same scale the old point-form source baked

falloff.note: 1 at the root fading to 0 at 128 units, so the gradient is visible across a standing body

outputs.note: Same distance field as height displacement
